Title: Public Preview: Azure Cosmos DB Mirroring with Private Endpoints

Body.Content:
Available now in Public Preview, you can configure Azure Cosmos DB accounts with virtual networks or private endpoints to work with Microsoft Fabric mirroring. This feature allows you to preserve your enhanced network security and seamlessly replicate your operational data in Cosmos DB using Mirroring into your Fabric Workspaces. 

Learn more.
